name: rea-gui
description: Visual interface for REA (Reverse Engineer Anything): guided app analysis, chat and every REA tool, locally or on a server.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && node scripts/copy-public.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.pretest: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.test: node test/smoke.ts && node test/chat.ts && node test/analyses.ts && node test/server.ts
